{{Quote|Just an unlucky wyvarl who didn't watch where she was going.|Luke Skywalker, regarding a wyvarl caught in a drop-bramble|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
A '''drop-bramble''' was a carnivorous [[Plant/Legends|plant]] located on [[Abeloth's planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. Drop-brambles had [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] barbs that could trap unsuspecting prey. When a [[wyvarl]] was caught in a drop-bramble in [[44 ABY]], the plant caused the [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] to ooze [[Color/Legends|yellow]] froth from its nostrils and have violent muscle spasms. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] saw the wyvarl and put it out of its misery by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to put it to sleep and then shooting it with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].
